Navigation Help

Hope this helps! Press h, ? or Left Arrow to return to your previous page.

KeyCommand
Esc, qQuit
`Go to guide index page
Down Arrow, d, kMove attention line down
Up Arrow, s, lMove attention line up
Right Arrow, Return, gFollow selected link
Left ArrowGo back to previous page
Home, x, .Go to first line
End, c, ,Go to last line
Tab, ]Select next link
Shift-Tab, [Select previous link
f, ;Move attention column right
a, jMove attention column left
/Search on this page
\Search the whole guide
nNext search hit
NPrevious search hit
=Show page address

Web links: press Enter twice to open them in your browser.

Answers: Right Arrow or + shows, Left Arrow or - hides, r next, * all.

Info Up: u Next/Previous node: n/p.

Level, kept across pages: 0 All, 1 Beginner, 2 Intermediate, 3 Expert.
